rows.label: The Hex
rows.note: quest complete; opens Höllvania and Eleanor

rows.label: Railjack Intrinsics rank 5
rows.note: any one class; Earth Proxima showdown

rows.label: Mastery Rank 17
rows.note: enforced when Eleanor sells the weapon

conditions: Only one adversary at a time: clear or convert any active Kuva Lich, Sister of Parvos, or other Coda first.
MR 17 is checked at the Eleanor purchase, not at Coda spawn. Heartcells farmed below MR 17 just sit there until you rank up.
No Hex standing rank is needed; the weapon sits at Eleanor Rank 0.

rows.label: Antivirus mods
rows.alt: trade for the straggler; veterans hand them out

conditions: Four duplicate or depleted mods of one type transmute into one fresh charged mod of that type. Do not grind the bounty for the last missing Antivirus.
Potency mods do nothing unless the correct Antivirus is equipped alongside them.
bonuses: Antivirus and Potency mods drop as public loot off any squadmate's stab, so pubbing tops you up even when your own Coda hasn't spawned.
Slot Quick Correct once you know your Antivirus: 10% chance per correct stab for a bonus Heartcell, which adds up across several Codas.

rows.label: spawn via Exterminate, Hell-Scrub or Legacyte Harvest
rows.note: Techrot drop a Mixtape; hack it, pass or fail

rows.label: correct Antivirus mercy
rows.note: all 3 equipped mods tested at once; no penalty for a wrong guess

rows.label: 100% disinfection
rows.note: 2 Potency mods once the Antivirus is known; missions alone cap at 95%

conditions: Each completed mission or Hex bounty on a Coda node adds 5%, capped at 95%. The last push to 100% must be a correct-Antivirus stab.
Duets spawn at 25% per mission, +25% per miss, guaranteed on the 4th.
A Duet that stumbles 3 times unstabbed, or a downed squad, flees the encounter.
Kill DJ RoM first in Duets: his Toxin bypasses shields and shield gating.
Phases 1 and 3 are hazard-dodging with Transference disabled; phases 2 and 4 are the real fight, and the frontman regenerates until his backup band is dead.
Bring overguard or invulnerability: Revenant's Mesmer Skin or Nyx with her Absorb augment, Valkyr and Dante also work. Shield-reliant frames like Gauss get deleted by the Toxin.
Stage Fright: getting hit 3 times by stage hazards doubles damage taken.
The Showdown is buggy: a band member can spawn invisible so the frontman keeps reviving, or the band refuses to jump down. If a run breaks, restart it.
bonuses: Abort right after a correct-Antivirus stab; the disinfection banks immediately. Quick Correct Heartcells are lost on abort.
Duets spawn during bounties too, so running the Antivirus Bounty on a Coda node stacks Hex standing, Antivirus mods and disinfection at once.
Each extra Coda defeated in the same Concert pays every player +1 Heartcell, up to +3 in a full squad, whether vanquished or converted.

groups.meta: Batch B, one copy per 4-day rotation
conditions: Tysis is Batch B, alongside Synapse, Bassocyst, Bubonico, Caustacyst, Hirudo and Pathocyst; Batch A carries no Tysis.
One purchase per weapon per rotation; rotations flip every 4 days at 0:00 UTC, and update releases can force an early flip.
An empty weapon slot is required before Eleanor will sell to you.
bonuses: Heartcells never expire, so bank them from one Coda and buy the next time the batch comes around.
60% Tysis rolls, Heat included, show up often enough that waiting a rotation is reasonable if you will use the gun. For Mastery alone, buy whatever roll is up.

conditions: Fusion takes the higher of the two bonuses × 1.1, capped at 60%.
Fuse into the copy holding your Forma and Catalyst; the donor's investments are destroyed.
Elemental Vice needs rank 40 (5 Forma): 50,000 Hex standing at Rank 5, 20 platinum from the Market, or a Temporal Archimedea/Nightwave drop.
bonuses: Mastery runs to rank 40 through 5 Forma, 4,000 in total.

disclosures.title: the arsenal under-reports it
disclosures.body: The dart and its Corrosive DoT are split, and the progenitor bonus applies to each separately. Several players still call the Tysis "meh" next to the Kuva Nukor.
